justification: The selected issue verb and issue-id option value are runtime inputs; refusal recovery uses the registered issue show/reopen verbs, and issue command tests pin the reachable emitted text.
The family adapter dispatches a runtime-selected issue command id; engine-authored recovery is transported verbatim and command behavior is covered by issue family tests.
The selected workflow verb determines the recovery route; each branch is a registered command and workflow command tests cover the runtime-selected path.

The recovery names the registered `mstar session run` verb with its required workflow/role options and a positional placeholder; the checker's tokenizer does not accept the angle-bracket placeholder here, while the emitted command is executable and the launch-scope tests cover it.
